controlledSchedule.overlap: Two tabs invoked replay while a route-readiness barrier held the first replay; one lease-owning network attempt proceeded after release.
controlledSchedule.accountSwitch: A second event's replay was held at route readiness, actor 17 switched to actor 22, then the response completed. The old request was not retroactively canceled or projected into actor 22's UI.

queue: Definite replay completion removed the first event from the actor queue; account switch purged the second actor-17 queue and emitted no committed UI event to actor 22.
